description: Na₂Ti₁₂O₂₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.92 Å. There are six inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-29°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.18 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-28°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.16 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-33°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.26 Å. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.30 Å. In the fifth Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.24 Å. In the sixth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 35°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.23 Å. There are thirteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Ti atoms to form distorted OTi₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra, corners with three OTi₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with four OTi₄ trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Ti atoms to form ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra, corners with three OTi₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one OTi₄ trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Ti atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to four Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OTi₄ trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ti atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to four Ti atoms to form distorted OTi₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three OTi₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent OTi₄ trigonal pyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two Ti atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na and two Ti atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to four Ti atoms to form distorted OTi₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra, corners with three OTi₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with four OTi₄ trigonal pyramids. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Ti atoms.
